title: 梅花（墙角数枝梅）
author: 王安石
intro: A few branches of plum blossom open alone in a corner in the depth of winter. From far away they look like snow — but a faint scent tells you otherwise.
analysis: 这首诗只有二十个字，写墙角的几枝梅花。“墙角”很不起眼，梅花却在最冷的时候“独自”开放——别的花都不开，它不怕冷，也不需要人看。后两句很巧：远远看去，白白的梅花像雪一样，但作者知道那不是雪，因为有一阵淡淡的香气飘过来。“暗香”是看不见、悄悄传来的香味。作者没有直接夸梅花，而是通过“像雪又不是雪”的对比，同时写出了梅花的颜色（白）和香气。这首诗也是“托物言志”（借写东西表达自己的志向）：梅花在寒冷中坚持开放，象征一个人在困境中仍保持高洁的品格。
analysisEn: Just twenty characters about a few branches of plum blossom in the corner of a wall. A wall corner is an easy place to overlook, yet the plum flowers open there “all alone” in the bitter cold, when nothing else is blooming — they don’t need warmth and they don’t need an audience. The second half is a neat little puzzle. From a distance the white blossoms look like snow, but the poet knows they aren’t, because a faint fragrance is drifting his way. 暗香 (“hidden fragrance”) means a scent you can’t see, one that reaches you quietly. Without praising the flowers directly, the comparison “like snow, but not snow” tells us two things at once: they are pure white, and they are fragrant. Chinese poets often describe an object to express their own ideals, and the plum is a favourite example: flowering in the cold, it stands for a person who stays upright and clean even in hard times.
background: Wang Anshi (1021–1086) was a chancellor of the Northern Song famous for his sweeping political reforms. The poem is often linked to his later years, after his reforms met fierce opposition and he withdrew to Jiangning (today’s Nanjing).
pronunciation: “数枝”的“数”读 shù（几），不读 shǔ。“为有”的“为”读 wèi（因为）。“凌寒”的“凌”读 líng。
version: 采用通行教材文本（统编小学语文二年级上册）。

lines.lit: In the corner of the wall, a few branches of plum,
lines.en: A few plum branches in a corner of the wall
brave the cold and bloom all on their own.

lines.lit: From afar I know it is not snow,
lines.en: Even from far off I can tell it isn’t snow —

lines.lit: because there is a hidden fragrance coming.
lines.en: a faint sweet scent comes drifting my way.

words.note: 数：几个。今天“数十人”“数次”还这样用。
诗词里常指梅花的香味。

imagery.name: 梅
imagery.zh: 墙角的梅花不怕寒冷、默默开放，象征坚强、高洁的人。
imagery.en: The plum in the corner blooms quietly through the cold — a picture of a strong, upright person.

imagery.name: 雪
imagery.zh: 用雪来比梅花的白，又用“不是雪”引出梅花的香。
imagery.en: Snow shows how white the blossoms are — and “not snow” leads us to their scent.
